A1.justification: Both complete, readable PDFs describe the same MDReID work. The main text, Equations 1–17, Figures 1–3, Tables 1–7, and Appendices A.1–A.5 support reliable comparison.

before.justification: v1 reports original MDReID retrieval results on three datasets, component ablations, efficiency measurements, and feature analyses in Section 4 and the appendices.

after.justification: v2 retains these original experiments and analyses, including benchmark results, ablations, computational measurements, and appendix visualizations.

M1.justification: Sections 3.1–3.4 retain the same shared/specific tokens, availability masks, similarity computation, ROL and KDL losses, and overall training objective.

E1.justification: Both evaluate the same person and vehicle retrieval tasks on RGBNT201, RGBNT100, and MSVR310. The six missing-modality settings on RGBNT201 and four mismatched scenarios across the three datasets are unchanged.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged in Tables 1–3, 5, and 7, including EDITOR and TOP-ReID for mismatched retrieval and DEEN in Appendix A.3. The newly cited works are not added to any experimental comparison.

E3.justification: Sections 4.1–4.2 retain identical dataset splits, query/gallery construction, mAP and CMC metrics, preprocessing, backbone, batch size of 64, and 50-epoch training budget. No additional evaluation protocol is introduced.

E4.justification: Table 4 retains the same component ablations and loss-weight sweeps. The missing-modality tests, computational analysis, shared/specific feature comparison, and t-SNE analysis in the appendices are also unchanged.

E5.justification: Neither version reports seeds, repeated-run counts, confidence intervals, error bars, or significance tests. The retained averages summarize evaluation settings rather than run-to-run uncertainty.

E6.justification: All result entries in Tables 1–7 and the qualitative findings remain unchanged. For example, Table 1 retains MDReID mAP values of 82.1, 85.3, and 51.0 on RGBNT201, RGBNT100, and MSVR310, respectively.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions, complete-modality training assumption, similarity formulas, and loss formulations in Equations 1–17 are unchanged. No theorem, proof, or derivation is added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same claims about any-to-any retrieval, modality decoupling, complementary metric-learning objectives, and performance gains. The scope and novelty claims are unchanged.

C2.justification: Interpretations of feature complementarity, robustness, and efficiency are unchanged. Appendix A.5 retains the same limitations concerning deployment accuracy, dataset scale and modality diversity, and uncertain generalization.

D1.justification: The implementation details, hardware, optimizer, learning rates, preprocessing, and hyperparameters remain identical. The code-availability statement and repository address are also unchanged.

R1.justification: Section 2 adds citations to Mambapro and Decoupled feature-based mixture of experts for multi-modal object re-identification, listed as v2 references 24–25. This modestly expands cited literature without adding substantive discussion or changing research positioning.

P1.justification: Changes are limited to citation renumbering, a bibliographic formatting edit for Magic Tokens, and the arXiv version/date label. Narrative wording, terminology, and section organization remain unchanged.

P2.justification: The added citations produce small line-wrapping and bibliography-spacing changes, including moving existing reference entries between pages 12 and 13. Figures 1–3 and Tables 1–7 retain their structure, captions, and placement.

improvement.justification: v2 modestly broadens attribution through two added related-work citations, but provides no substantive comparison or explanation of those works. The methods, empirical evidence, reproducibility information, and limitations remain unchanged; the minor bibliographic edits do not meaningfully alter overall paper quality.
